title_short: Gabriela (Haven shelter support) · Never Too Far Gone
headline: She was homeless for four years. Now she works at The Haven, sober, to show others that nobody is ever too far gone.
story: Gabriela was homeless for four years. She has been off the streets and sober for a year and six months, and she is grateful she can help others have hope.
She went back to the place where she was broken to shine the light for others. People who are homeless get judged, but there is a root behind it.
Turn: when residents get an apartment or a job, tears of joy come out. Button: her courage: she didn't let her circumstances decide who she is.
do: Open on her four years and her year and six months, with the hook text on screen at 0:00.
Lower third from 00:03: Gabriela / Shelter Support, The Haven. First name only.
Use the side angle (C4903) to hide the joins.
dont: Nothing that dwells on the drug years.
No logo before the end card.
No resident's face clear in any B-roll.
